selection_reason: assignment of element text property with user-controlled content -> direct DOM manipulation -> potential XSS if property is tainted
source_summary: Element text content from DOM elements selected by target parameter, which can be CSS selector string or element collection. Content originates from HTML markup or previous DOM manipulations.
sink_summary: DOM textContent/innerText property assignment, which can execute HTML/script if content contains unescaped markup
guard_summary: No input sanitization or escaping before assignment. The operation occurs in a conditional branch for previously-shaved elements, but no security controls validate or escape the text content.
risk_pattern: Direct assignment of potentially unsanitized DOM text content back to the same element's text property, which could execute script content if the original element contained HTML/script markup
enclosing_conditions: if (span) - executes when element has already been shaved and contains .js-shave span
context_summary: The assignment occurs when re-processing a previously truncated element. It removes the ellipsis character span and reassigns the element's text property to itself, potentially re-interpreting HTML content
unresolved_facts: Whether the original element content is trusted/controlled by the application or could contain attacker-controlled data
Whether the library is typically used with sanitized/trusted content only
